name: @local/dsh-think-box
description: Puts model reasoning into an inline reasoning box beside the Think row: a three-line preview, click to open the full body (up to 18 lines, shrinking for short content), click again to collapse; when thinking ends it settles back to the first line and collapses, one flourish per stream and never replayed for restored history. Reasoning reveal uses one fixed balanced cadence and the logarithmic fade stays on; both are skipped under OS reduced motion. The Think row switches between the translation and the original: the official reasoning-translation bundle chooses the service, or any registered DSH model route can be used; the translation channel offers a provider / model / reasoning-effort picker matching the composer model menu (provider groups, search, effort list), with selections staged and written only by the channel's Save. While streaming only finished fragments are translated and the tail stays original; historical reasoning blocks are always manual. The Plugins-page settings card is always expanded, no click needed: enabled, auto-follow reasoning, and the translation channel (backend, model route, target language, fragment limit, auto-translate; maxTokens / timeoutMs live in the translation.json seed only). enabled / thinkAutoExpand persist in the profile cordis.patch.yml entry and apply live; translation settings persist in ~/.dsh/think-box/translation.json. Enabling translation sends reasoning text to the selected service or model route; autoTranslate controls automatic sending; historical blocks stay manual. Tested on DSH 0.2.3-alpha.2; requires >=0.2.3-alpha.2 <0.3.0; the plugin depends on non-public seams (assistant-step swap, groupPart split, turnProcess fold, connection RPC, volatile config + configEditor) and must be regressed after upgrades. Translation covers the reasoning box only, not the answer. The full suite is 155/155 green with no skips.

meta.title: 思维链显示增强
meta.description: 把模型的思考过程放进「思考」行右侧的行内思考窗：默认三行，点击展开完整 body（最多 18 行，内容短时按内容收缩），再点收起；思考结束回卷到开头并收成一行，每段只播一次，恢复历史不重播。推理文本按固定 balanced 节奏逐字揭示，对数淡入固定开启；系统「减少动效」下两者自动跳过。思考行右侧可切换「查看译文 / 查看原文」：官方「思考过程翻译」组合包由它决定服务，或使用任意已注册的 DSH 模型路由；翻译通道提供与输入框模型菜单一致的模型路由选择器（服务商 / 模型 / 推理强度，按服务商分组的模型列表、搜索框与推理强度列表），选择只暂存，点翻译通道的保存才写入；流式期间只翻译已完成的片段，末尾保持原文，历史思考块始终手动。插件页设置卡始终展开、无需点击：启用、自动跟随思考、翻译通道（后端、模型路由、目标语言、分片上限、自动翻译；maxTokens / timeoutMs 只在 translation.json 种子里）；enabled / thinkAutoExpand 写在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 条目并即时生效，翻译设置写在 ~/.dsh/think-box/translation.json。启用翻译意味着思考文本会发送到你选择的翻译服务或模型路由；autoTranslate 控制自动发送，历史块始终手动。实测 DSH 0.2.3-alpha.2，要求 >=0.2.3-alpha.2 <0.3.0；插件依赖若干非公开接缝（assistant-step 原地替换、groupPart 双挂载、turnProcess 折叠、连接 RPC、volatile 配置 + configEditor），升级 DSH 后必须回归；翻译只覆盖思考框，不翻译正文。全量测试 155/155 通过、无 skip。
